Hold 判断中隐含的偏空倾向仅得到微弱验证：0700.HK 上涨 +0.7%，但跑输恒生指数 -0.3%，因此相对弱势得到证实，但绝对价格并未下跌，验证了在 421.20 点位拒绝追空（风险回报比 <0.6）的决策——任何战术做空操作都会产生亏损。站得住脚的部分是 418.25 的支撑位配合 30–40% 的核心仓位规则，使得风险敞口保持纪律性，且无需触发紧急抛售。失败的部分在于，股价在该区间内低波动震荡，既未触及下方的突破触发点，也未触及 447.51 的上行失效点，导致整个框架仅有区间突破预案。教训：在 ATR 压缩至 11.58 时，应将区间震荡作为基准假设，除了突破触发点外，增加区间中值回归战术，并在基准对比下评估 Hold 操作，而非基于绝对收益。

[2026-10-05 | 3690.HK | Underweight | +1.6%]
The Underweight call was directionally wrong: 3690.HK rose +1.6%, outperforming the HSI by +0.7%, moving away from the 68.0 target instead of toward it. What held was the risk overlay — the bull-side warning that net cash ¥80.2B, RSI 32, P/B 2.19 at historical lows, and proximity to the 52-week low made aggressive shorting squeeze-prone proved correct, and the decision's structure (1–2% tactical short, batches at 73.2/74.6, never a naked SELL) capped the drag to 0.7%. What failed was the bearish momentum read: price below all MAs and the 50/200 death cross delivered no near-term downside because the TTM loss and negative OCF/FCF were already public and priced at P/B 2.19. Lesson: when deteriorating fundamentals are already disclosed, treat valuation percentile and oversold momentum as binding constraints — require a confirmed breakdown (close below 67.88) or a fresh catalyst before underweighting near the lows.
